item.text: {"analysis":"The trial succeeded operationally and achieved host validation macro HR@10 of 0.4388: +0.0213 over the supplied 0.4175 predecessor, but −0.0662 below the 0.505 SASRec baseline. Category HR@10 was Movies 0.455, Industrial 0.445, Electronics 0.325, and CDs 0.530. Replacing summed BCE with cross-entropy over one positive and 32 uniform negatives improved the aggregate result in this run, consistent with relative candidate competition helping ranking. This single comparison does not establish robustness or explain individual category changes. Electronics remains the weakest category. Allocated GPU time was 662.65 seconds.","code_summary":"Trains one independent AttentiveItemSimilarity network per category. Separate source and target embeddings feed candidate-conditioned nonlinear attention over history, with learned recency decay, history-length normalization, score scaling, and item bias. The isolated change uses float32 cross-entropy at temperature 1 with positive index zero, 32 existing negatives, and no label smoothing. AdamW, mixed precision, gradient clipping, prefix sampling, five-epoch validation cadence, and 40-epoch patience remain unchanged. Each category reloads one best-validation checkpoint; generated prediction code reconstructs the same architecture and verifies score agreement. All four dataset routes remain intact, with no ensembles or separately fitted scoring components."}
